<solution_file path="src/solution.py">
# Python script to compute stop-level service intensity
import pandas as pd
import os

# Read input files
stops_df = pd.read_csv('outputs/t05_clean_stops.csv')
stop_times_df = pd.read_csv('outputs/t05_clean_stop_times.csv')
trips_df = pd.read_csv('inputs/gtfs/sample_city_gtfs.zip/trips.txt')

# Join stop_times with stops to get stop_id, stop_name, stop_lat, stop_lon
stop_times_df['stop_name'] = stop_times_df['stop_id'].map(stops_df['stop_name'])
stop_times_df['stop_lat'] = stop_times_df['stop_id'].map(stops_df['stop_lat'])
stop_times_df['stop_lon'] = stop_times_df['stop_id'].map(stops_df['stop_lon'])

# Merge stop_times with stops to join route info
stop_times_df['route_id'] = stop_times_df['trip_id'].map(trips_df['route_id'].map(trips_df['route_id']))

# Calculate n_departures (count of stop_times per stop_id)
stop_times_df['n_departures'] = stop_times_df['stop_id'].apply(lambda x: stop_times_df[stop_times_df['stop_id'] == x].shape[0])

# Calculate n_routes (distinct route_id per stop)
stop_times_df['route_id'] = stop_times_df['trip_id'].map(trips_df['route_id'])
stop_times_df['n_routes'] = stop_times_df['route_id'].apply(lambda x: len(set(trips_df[trips_df['route_id'] == x]['route_id'])))

# Calculate first_departure and last_departure
stop_times_df['first_departure'] = stop_times_df['departure_time'].min()
stop_times_df['last_departure'] = stop_times_df['departure_time'].max()

# Create final output dataframe
output_df = stop_times_df[['stop_id', 'stop_name', 'stop_lat', 'stop_lon', 'n_departures', 'n_routes', 'first_departure', 'last_departure']]

# Write output with proper RFC 4180 compliance
os.makedirs('outputs', exist_ok=True)
output_df.to_csv('outputs/t06_stop_service_intensity.csv', index=False, encoding='utf-8')
print("Output written to outputs/t06_stop_service_intensity.csv")
</solution_file>
